headline: Less time on records. More time for students.
linkedin:
When tracking student attendance, losing daily entries or struggling to pull counts creates unnecessary friction. I created AttendEase as a browser-based tracker with per-date auto-save, search and filtering tools, and live stats that update as you work.

To make sure the records can be used beyond the browser session, I also built in Excel export, CSV backup, and print support.

Code: https://github.com/sourav-bwn/attendance-system
